review_notes: Reviewed all 53 lines, including both theorem statements and proofs. The same potentially stronger-than-needed separation assumption appears in both declarations; the supporting compact-integration lemma also has no T2 assumption.

findings.excerpt:
{S Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [CompactSpace S] [T2Space S]
    [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] [PseudoMetricSpace Y]
findings.problem: Both theorems require S to be Hausdorff, but their proofs use compactness, continuity and the Borel measurable structure—not separation. This excludes compact non-Hausdorff spaces without an apparent mathematical need.
findings.proposed_change: In both declarations, replace `[TopologicalSpace S] [CompactSpace S] [T2Space S]` with `[TopologicalSpace S] [CompactSpace S]`. The proof can retain its continuous map construction and compact-support integrability argument, then apply `exists_le_integral` as before; the concentration result still follows by squeeze.
findings.benefit: Makes the results available for compact non-Hausdorff profile spaces while preserving the existing conclusion and proof strategy.
